supportBlocks.content: Nothing (R) Explore Offers Learn More CMF Phone 2 Pro 5000 mAh battery 8 gb ram Four-camera system White White Light Green Orange Black 8+256GB 8+256GB 8+128GB £249 Sold out Notify me Disclaimer 1. Appearance disclaimer: The smartphone's appearance showcased on the page is for reference purposes only. Colours and finishes may slightly vary in different environments. 2. Illustrative feature images: Creative feature images displayed on the page are purely illustrative and do not represent the actual device structure; they are intended for demonstration purposes. 3. Processor performance comparison: All comparisons regarding the processor are benchmarked against Nothing CMF Phone 1 as per Nothing testing laboratory results. 4. Charging and battery data source: All data regarding charging and battery life on this page are sourced from Nothing testing laboratories. Actual results may vary due to differences in software versions, environments and phone models and may not exactly reflect the performance of the actual product. 5. Charge time varies with device settings and environmental factors. Actual results will vary. 6. Display performance comparison: Screen peak brightness and touch sampling rate are benchmarked against Nothing CMF Phone 1 as per Nothing testing laboratory results. 7. Water and dust resistance certification: The device is certified IP54 for resistance to splash, water, and dust under specific laboratory conditions. However, this water resistance is applicable only in controlled environments and may not correspond to typical consumer use. Ingress protection is not guaranteed outside test conditions. Testing by users is not recommended, and the product is not advised for beach or pool use. Ingress protection may degrade due to daily wear, physical damage, or disassembly required for repair. Charging, operating physical buttons, or removing the sim tray in moist conditions is discouraged. Liquid damage in environments beyond IP54 conditions is not covered by the warranty. 8. Caution on testing water resistance: Users are strongly advised against testing water resistance independently, and the product is not suitable for beach or pool use. Ingress protection may degrade due to daily wear, physical damage, or disassembly needed for repair. 9. Memory and storage variation clarification: Actual available memory and storage capacity may vary or be reduced due to factors such as the operating system occupying part of the memory (RAM) and pre-installed programs using part of the flash memory (ROM). 10. RAM and ROM relationship clarification: The 16 GB RAM specification is based on the 8 GB RAM version. Creating additional RAM will utilise a selected amount of ROM storage on the device. Memory extension is possible when sufficient storage space is available, and the extension capacity varies across different models. 11. 5G and NFC variation notice: 5G functionality requires support from local telecom operator services and may not be available in all regions. NFC functions may vary in some markets.
